original_target.title: Linear growth of interior Steklov nodal volume
original_target.outcome: Claim: steklov counterexample claim; product reduction checked, underlying nodal-growth theorem awaiting independent review.

scope_comparison: The source supplies a fixed smooth closed5-manifold and eigenfunctions phi_j whose nodal4-volume exceeds every stated square-root eigenvalue bound. On its product with[-L,L], U=phi_j cosh(sqrt(lambda_j)t) is harmonic with the same outward Steklov eigenvalue sqrt(lambda_j)tanh(Lsqrt(lambda_j)) on both smooth boundary components. Its interior nodal5-volume is2L times the original nodal volume, refuting the universal upper linear Steklov bound in dimension6. No lower-bound resolution is asserted.
